steps.detail: Both fixed Compose configurations validate; foundation container project is initially empty.
Actual operator unlock, strict HttpOnly session and validated port8180 configuration succeeded; credentials stayed in memory.
Genuine pre-migration smoke failed FND-PG-01; PostgreSQL independently confirmed the correct database, existing runtime/migrator roles and absent migration table.
Two migration executions, restricted runtime privileges, current worker heartbeat and committed retention marker passed.
Actual control deployment reached ready; gateway readiness and honest foundation API summary passed.
Private internal filer accepted a controlled fixture write and identical read; no POD authorisation claim.
Container recreation preserved database marker and private filer object; worker heartbeat and gateway readiness passed.
Stopping storage produced API503; independent control remained available; recovery restored readiness and retained database marker.
Stopping database produced API503; independent control remained available; recovery restored readiness and retained database marker.
